comment: PX-S88T OTTAWA 1.06 D8 DATA_C2_SUB and data-track admission, with 4x special negative acquisition

patches.comment: Admit D8 modes 0..3 and 8 through the existing validation mask
Translate mode 8 to internal format 4 in R0L and enable the existing C2 capture and transfer flag
Exempt only D8 from the data-track restriction, retaining media and range checks
48-byte H8S format and data-track admission adapters in erased main-image space
Apply the negative acquisition speed cap before publishing the acquisition speed
Cap special negative acquisition at 4x for requests of at least 4x, preserving ordinary-read speed policy and the original request
